description: Search 1,486 ski resorts in the Alps (AT, CH, DE, IT, FR, SI). Get snow forecasts, resort details, driving times from any city, powder-day alerts, side-by-side resort comparisons, and route maps. Data includes piste kilometers, lifts, elevation, glacier status, current snow depth, ski passes, and 16-day weather forecasts from Open-Meteo. Ask things like: "Which ski resorts are within 2 hours of Stuttgart?" - "Where is the most snow next week?" - "Soelden or Ischgl, which is bigger?" - "Show me the route to Zermatt".
